born.why: The code prioritizes survival by aggressively switching to rest ('a4') when danger (n1) exceeds critical thresholds (92% and 75%), ensuring the agent doesn't die from high risk, and limits approach behavior to lower danger levels to minimize exposure.

The code prioritizes survival by strictly avoiding actions that increase n1 when n1 is already high, and aggressively seeking healing (negative cost) items to lower n1, while using history only when the current state is safe.

The code prioritizes survival by aggressively retreating ('a4') when health drops below critical thresholds (90, 75, 50) or when pending damage would leave a dangerously low safety margin, while allowing risk-taking only when health is high and pending loss is minimal.
This code prioritizes survival by checking estimated risk before choosing, uses history to identify profitable moves only when safe, and defaults to the safest option ('a4') near death limits.

The code prioritizes survival by overriding risky default choices with 'a4' when n1 is high or n2 is low, and prevents approaching items that pose significant risk without reward to keep the agent alive longer.

This code prioritizes survival by explicitly checking if an item's effect on n1 will cause immediate death (n2 >= 100) and avoiding such items, while leveraging past successful interactions to optimize profit when safe.

The code prioritizes survival by enforcing hard stops at high danger levels (>=90) and conservative behavior (defaulting to stop 'a4') when danger is elevated (>=70), while still following the default action when risk is low to maximize utility.
